title: Incredible app - so helpful and user friendly!
body: I’m sad I didn’t find this app sooner it is literally life changing. Easiest way to keep track of medication and a very comprehensive but easy to use symptom tracker to help keep track of daily issues to keep my specialist informed when appointments come around. I currently run the free version as I can’t afford the premium .. if I love the free version this much I can only imagine how good the premium is!
author: Flicka 101

title: ADHD GAME CHANGER
body: I love Bearble so much. I have a terrible memory, and just about no perception of time or ability to remember things in the correct order. This makes attempting to correlate things like mood or side effects against a medication is impossible without recording all that stuff every day and Bearable is by far the best app I’ve found for doing that!
author: Seb Steel

title: Best mood tracking app out there
body:
I have bi polar disorder, and one of the most important tools in treatment aside from medication and talk therapy is tracking mood and sleep etc. Bearable is the best app out there for this purpose - it has exactly everything you need, and if it doesn’t then it is easily customisable to add extra moods or symptoms in. Once customised, you can easily tap on a symptom and even rate its severity. I like that even when I’m in a low, the app is easy to use and intuitive so on the days I can’t get out of bed, I don’t lose valuable data that’s important for keeping on top of my health. I like that you can also break it down further and add multiple moods throughout the day which is really helpful for us rapid cycling folk, and also break down symptoms into times of day as well which may support other people with things like BPD or people looking to track their triggers for anxiety for example.
Absolutely fantastic app - couldn’t recommend more highly! Wish there was a 6 star option!!
